mapper.insert: insert into micro_ai_chat_session (session_id, tenant_code, user_id, title, msg_count, status, last_msg_time, created_by, created_date, last_upd_by, last_upd_date, active_flag) values (#{sessionId}, #{tenantCode}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{msgCount}, #{status}, #{lastMsgTime}, #{createdBy}, #{createdDate}, #{lastUpdBy}, #{lastUpdDate}, #{activeFlag})
mapper.select: select * from micro_ai_chat_session where tenant_code = #{tenantCode} and user_id = #{userId} and active_flag = '1' order by last_msg_time desc, id desc
mapper.update: update micro_ai_chat_session set msg_count = #{msgCount}, last_msg_time = #{lastMsgTime}, status = case when #{msgCount} >= 200 then '20' else '10' end, last_upd_by = #{lastUpdBy}, last_upd_date = now() where session_id = #{sessionId}
